name: arnica montana + magnesium sulfate unspecified + witch hazel
uses: For the temporary relief of pain associated with minor skin procedures
otcwarn: Do Not Use on large areas of the body or on cut, irritated or swollen skin on puncture wounds for more than one week without consulting a doctor Stop use and ask a doctor if Condition worsens redness is present Irritation develops symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. you experience signs of skin injury, such as pain, swelling, or blistering where the product was applied.
